title.es: Lo que había llevado a ello

es: Explicar por qué pasó algo contando primero el hecho y después la causa previa con had o had been, con by the time y conectores de resultado.

teaching.en: By the time Leo arrived, the first lesson had already started.
teaching.es: Para cuando Leo llegó, la primera clase ya había empezado.
teaching.explanationEs: By the time + pasado simple fija el momento; lo anterior va en had + participio.
segments: By the time Leo arrived, the
teaching.audioText: By the time Leo arrived, the first lesson had already started.

teaching.en: The reason he was late was simple: he had been studying until two, so he overslept.
teaching.es: La razón de su retraso era simple: había estado estudiando hasta las dos, así que se quedó dormido.
teaching.explanationEs: Had been studying explica la causa larga; overslept es la consecuencia.
segments: The reason he was late was simple: he
had been studying until two, so he overslept.
teaching.audioText: The reason he was late was simple: he had been studying until two, so he overslept.

teaching.en: The bus driver had been waiting for five minutes, but eventually he drove away.
teaching.es: El conductor llevaba cinco minutos esperando, pero con el tiempo se marchó.
teaching.explanationEs: Had been waiting: la espera previa; eventually marca el final de esa espera.
segments: The bus driver had been waiting for
five minutes, but eventually he drove away.
teaching.audioText: The bus driver had been waiting for five minutes, but eventually he drove away.

teaching.en: What was the cause? His phone had died, so the alarm hadn't rung.
teaching.es: ¿Cuál fue la causa? Su teléfono se había apagado, así que la alarma no había sonado.
teaching.explanationEs: Dos causas previas con had: had died y hadn't rung.
segments: What was the cause? His phone had
died, so the alarm hadn't rung.
teaching.audioText: What was the cause? His phone had died, so the alarm hadn't rung.

teaching.en: A late night led to a late morning, and the result was a missed lesson.
teaching.es: Una noche tardía llevó a una mañana tardía, y el resultado fue una clase perdida.
teaching.explanationEs: Led to y result enlazan la causa con la consecuencia.
segments: A late night led to a late morning,
and the result was a missed lesson.
teaching.audioText: A late night led to a late morning, and the result was a missed lesson.

prompt.es: Completa: «Cuando Tom llegó a casa, su hermana ya se había comido todo el pastel.»

feedback.es: Tras by the time + pasado simple, lo anterior es had eaten (o had already eaten).

hint.es: El pastel ya no estaba cuando Tom llegó: es un hecho terminado antes.

origin.text: By the time Tom got home, his sister ___ all the cake.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase explica la causa con una actividad que duraba?

choices.text: Ana was late because she has fixed her bike.
Ana was late because she was fix her bike.
Ana was late because she had been fixing her bike.

feedback.es: Had been fixing presenta la reparación como actividad anterior; has fixed usa el presente y was fix es incorrecta.

hint.es: Busca la causa que venía ocurriendo antes del retraso, en pasado.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para cuando llegué, el tren ya se había ido.»

feedback.es: By the time + pasado simple fija el momento de llegada; lo anterior va en had left.

hint.es: Es la preposición con la que empieza la expresión «para cuando».

origin.text: ___ the time I arrived, the train had left.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Para cuando llegamos, la película ya había empezado.»

answer.text: By the time we arrived the film had already started

feedback.es: By the time + pasado simple abre la frase y la película adelantada va en had already started.

prompt.es: Completa cada causa con had done o had been doing.

answer.text: had been studying | had washed | had been waiting
accepted: had been studying | had washed | had been waiting

feedback.es: All night y for an hour piden una causa con duración (had been + -ing; también se admite had + participio); twice cuenta veces: es un resultado, had washed.

sentences: Sara was tired because she ___ (study) all night.
The floor was clean because Dad ___ (wash) it twice.
My hands were cold because I ___ (wait) outside for an hour.

prompt.es: Escribe en inglés la causa del retraso de Leo.

answer.text: Leo was late because he had been helping his grandmother all afternoon.
accepted: Leo was late because he had been helping his grandmother all afternoon.
Leo arrived late because he had been helping his grandma all afternoon.
Leo was late because he had been helping his grandma all afternoon.
Leo arrived late because he had been helping his grandmother all afternoon.

feedback.es: La causa previa es una actividad larga: had been helping + all afternoon.

origin.text: Leo llegó tarde al entrenamiento. Causa: había estado ayudando a su abuela toda la tarde.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué estaba de mal humor Tom.

choices.text: He had been waiting for a long time.
He had missed the first bus.

feedback.es: El audio dice que Tom llevaba cuarenta minutos esperando: una causa previa larga que explica su enfado.

origin.audio: By the time the bus came, Tom had been waiting for forty minutes, so he was cold and angry.

prompt.es: Completa: «El jardín era un desastre porque había estado lloviendo toda la semana.»

feedback.es: All week pide la causa con duración: had been raining (had rained también se admite).

origin.text: The garden was a mess because it ___ all week.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase une bien la causa previa con el resultado?

choices.text: Tom overslept although his alarm hadn't rung.
Tom overslept because his alarm hadn't rung.
Tom overslept so his alarm hadn't rung.

feedback.es: Because introduce la causa (la alarma no sonó) y el resultado es que Tom se quedó dormido; although y so cambian la lógica.

prompt.es: Cuenta por qué Mia llegó tarde en unas 50 palabras: hecho, causa previa y resultado.

answer.text: Yesterday Mia was late for class. By the time she arrived, the lesson had already started. She had been waiting for a bus for half an hour, but it never came, so she walked to school. As a result, she missed the first exercise. Then she sat down and worked hard.
accepted: Yesterday Mia was late for class. By the time she arrived, the lesson had already started. She had been waiting for a bus for half an hour, but it never came, so she walked to school. As a result, she missed the first exercise. Then she sat down and worked hard.

Mia arrived late for class yesterday. By the time she got there, the lesson had already begun. She had been waiting for the bus for thirty minutes, but it never came, so she walked. As a result, she missed the first exercise. Then she told her teacher the reason, and everything was fine.

Yesterday Mia was late for class because her bus never came. She had been waiting for half an hour, so she walked to school. By the time she arrived, the lesson had already started, and as a result she missed the first exercise. Then she sat down and worked hard.

feedback.es: Un buen texto cuenta el hecho (was late), vuelve a la causa previa con had been waiting + half an hour, fija el momento con by the time y cierra con un conector de resultado.

origin.text: Mia llegó tarde a clase ayer. Escribe unas 50 palabras (mínimo 40): cuenta que llegó tarde y que, para cuando llegó, la clase ya había empezado; explica la causa previa (había estado esperando un autobús media hora, pero nunca llegó, así que fue andando); añade el resultado (se perdió el primer ejercicio) y usa conectores de secuencia.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Mia estaba molesta porque había perdido sus llaves.»

answer.text: Mia was upset because she had lost her keys

feedback.es: La causa anterior (perder las llaves) va en had lost después de because.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase marca el momento con by the time?

choices.text: By the time Ana called, I left.
By the time Ana had called, I left.
By the time Ana called, I had left.

feedback.es: By the time + pasado simple (called) fija el momento; lo anterior es had left.

prompt.es: Completa: «Perdió el autobús; como resultado, llegó tarde a clase.»

feedback.es: As a result introduce la consecuencia de lo anterior.

origin.text: He missed the bus; ___, he was late for class.
